# W7 Test – setup

The test instructions come later, on Moodle.

1. Open **this folder** in VS Code (File > Open Folder).
2. Click `SETUP.md` (this file): it opens as a preview with a picture below. Raw text instead? Press `Cmd+Shift+V` (Mac) or `Ctrl+Shift+V` (Windows).
3. Terminal: `flutter pub get`
4. Terminal: `flutter run -d chrome --no-web-resources-cdn`
   (Old Flutter says the option is unknown: run `flutter run -d chrome`.)
5. Chrome shows this screen. Raise your hand.

![Expected screen](data:image/png;base64,)

Keep the terminal and the Chrome window open. Don't close them.
